sources.title: aidenlopez/poolformer-demo · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Poolformer for Multitask. The base configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.

sources.snippet: A small Poolformer implementation for Retrieval, packaged with an explicit configuration and an initialization checkpoint. The giant variant is a reproducible starting point, not a trained model release.

sources.title: Poolformer: Recurrent Networks with Pooling for Long-Sequence Modeling
sources.snippet: We introduce Poolformer, a sequence-to-sequence model that replaces self-attention with recurrent layers and incorporates pooling operations to reduce sequence length. Poolformer is defined recursively using SkipBlocks, which contain residual blocks, a down-pooling layer, a nested SkipBlock, an up-pooling layer, and additional residual blocks.

sources.title: Contents
sources.snippet: In addition, Poolformer outperforms state-of-the-art models such as SaShiMi [13] and Mamba [14]. Chapter 5 contains the conclusions, and future research directions, that include applications to text and vision, as well as multi-modal scenarios, where a Poolformer-based LLM could effectively process dense representations of images and videos.
